caption: LUM-1328 composer paste: a bracketed paste (the byte sequence a terminal sends once the app enables the mode, `ESC [ 2 0 0 ~ … ESC [ 2 0 1 ~`) lands in the composer as ONE insertion — three lines stay a three-row draft with no turn started, twelve lines become a `[paste #1 +12 lines]` marker, Backspace removes the whole marker, and Enter hands the model the twelve lines the marker stands for. Before this round the mode was never requested (`pi-coding-agent`'s `setup_terminal`) and `CtEvent::Paste` had no consumer, so the same bytes were replayed as keystrokes: every newline in the block was an `Enter` and the draft was submitted line by line. Every frame is a real PTY at 76x26 driving the debug binary built from this commit; `probe` rows name behaviour only the fixed binary can show (they XFAIL on the `6a5a2faf2` baseline of the same scenario).

panels.label: 1. idle: header hint + one composer row
2. a one-line bracketed paste lands as text at the cursor

probe.why: the paste payload reached the composer as one insertion (pre-fix the CSI bytes were replayed as keys)

panels.label: 3. Ctrl+U empties the composer again, so the next demo starts clean

probe.why: the composer is empty again (placeholder back)

panels.label: 4. a three-line paste is a three-row draft — no turn started (the reject row is the pre-fix defect: three submissions)

probe.why: the third pasted line sits in the composer with the caret after it (the transcript never draws `▍`)

reject.why: no turn ran: pre-fix every newline of the block submitted, so the pasted draft produced three of them

panels.label: 5. Enter sends the whole three-line draft as ONE turn

probe.why: exactly one turn ran for the whole draft
the third line travelled with the same submission

panels.label: 6. a twelve-line paste becomes a [paste #1 +12 lines] marker instead of twelve rows

panels.label: 10. the other half of the story: the byte form a terminal sends with the mode OFF is plain keystrokes, so `raw two` was submitted as its own turn (both binaries behave this way — it is why the mode has to be requested)

and the second, which is the pre-fix paste symptom in byte form
